reference: Baseline: the underlying on its own, no option reference applies
notes: The trivial structure strategies compare against; no strike or expiry.

reference: B3 Edu, “Opções” (https://edu.b3.com.br/w/opcoes): compra de calls para exposição direcional
notes: Long an at-the-money call. Loss limited to the premium paid; gain grows with the underlying.

reference: B3 Edu, “Opções” (https://edu.b3.com.br/w/opcoes): compra de puts para exposição direcional
notes: Long an at-the-money put. Loss limited to the premium paid; gains as the underlying falls.

reference: Hull, Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives (10th ed. 2018, 11th ed. 2021), ch. 12 “Trading Strategies Involving Options”, “Trading an Option and the Underlying Asset” (writing a covered call); B3 Edu, “Opções” (https://edu.b3.com.br/w/opcoes): lançamento coberto
notes: Long the underlying, short a call 5% out of the money: premium income, upside capped at the strike.

reference: Hull, Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives (10th ed. 2018, 11th ed. 2021), ch. 12 “Trading Strategies Involving Options”, “Trading an Option and the Underlying Asset” (protective put)
notes: Long the underlying and a put 5% out of the money: loss below the strike is floored, at the cost of the premium.

reference: Hull, Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives (10th ed. 2018, 11th ed. 2021), ch. 12 “Trading Strategies Involving Options”, “Trading an Option and the Underlying Asset”: a protective put financed by a covered call, the two positions of that section held together
notes: Long the underlying, a put 5% below and a short call 5% above: the call's premium pays for part of the floor, and caps the upside.

reference: Hull, Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives (10th ed. 2018, 11th ed. 2021), ch. 12 “Trading Strategies Involving Options”, “Spreads” (bull spreads created from calls); B3 Edu, “Opções” (https://edu.b3.com.br/w/opcoes): travas de alta
notes: Debit spread: long the lower-strike call, short the higher. Gain and loss both bounded.

reference: Hull, Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives (10th ed. 2018, 11th ed. 2021), ch. 12 “Trading Strategies Involving Options”, “Spreads” (bull spreads created from puts); B3 Edu, “Opções” (https://edu.b3.com.br/w/opcoes): travas de alta
notes: Credit spread: long the lower-strike put, short the higher. Keeps the credit if the underlying stays above the upper strike.

reference: Hull, Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives (10th ed. 2018, 11th ed. 2021), ch. 12 “Trading Strategies Involving Options”, “Spreads” (bear spreads created from calls); B3 Edu, “Opções” (https://edu.b3.com.br/w/opcoes): travas de baixa
notes: Credit spread: short the lower-strike call, long the higher. Keeps the credit if the underlying stays below the lower strike.

reference: Hull, Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives (10th ed. 2018, 11th ed. 2021), ch. 12 “Trading Strategies Involving Options”, “Spreads” (bear spreads created from puts); B3 Edu, “Opções” (https://edu.b3.com.br/w/opcoes): travas de baixa
notes: Debit spread: short the lower-strike put, long the higher. Gain and loss both bounded.

reference: Hull, Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives (10th ed. 2018, 11th ed. 2021), ch. 12 “Trading Strategies Involving Options”, “Spreads” (box spreads)
notes: A bull call spread plus a bear put spread on the same two strikes: pays the strike difference at expiry whatever the underlying does, so it behaves like a fixed-income position. Hull notes the riskless payoff holds for European options only.

reference: Hull, Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives (10th ed. 2018, 11th ed. 2021), ch. 12 “Trading Strategies Involving Options”, “Spreads” (butterfly spreads created from calls)
notes: Long one call at each wing and short two at the middle strike: gains most if the underlying ends near the middle strike.

reference: Hull, Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives (10th ed. 2018, 11th ed. 2021), ch. 12 “Trading Strategies Involving Options”, “Spreads” (butterfly spreads created from puts)
notes: The put version of the call butterfly, with the same payoff shape.

reference: Hull, Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives (10th ed. 2018, 11th ed. 2021), ch. 12 “Trading Strategies Involving Options”, “Combinations” (straddle; bottom straddle or straddle purchase)
notes: Long a call and a put at the same at-the-money strike: gains on a large move either way, loses both premiums if the underlying stays put.

reference: Hull, Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives (10th ed. 2018, 11th ed. 2021), ch. 12 “Trading Strategies Involving Options”, “Combinations” (top straddle or straddle write)
notes: Short a call and a put at the same strike: keeps both premiums if the underlying stays near it; loss is unbounded above. B3 margin requirements are not modeled.

reference: Hull, Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives (10th ed. 2018, 11th ed. 2021), ch. 12 “Trading Strategies Involving Options”, “Combinations” (strips and straps)
notes: Long one call and two puts at the same strike: a straddle that pays more on a fall.

reference: Hull, Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives (10th ed. 2018, 11th ed. 2021), ch. 12 “Trading Strategies Involving Options”, “Combinations” (strips and straps)
notes: Long two calls and one put at the same strike: a straddle that pays more on a rise.

reference: Hull, Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives (10th ed. 2018, 11th ed. 2021), ch. 12 “Trading Strategies Involving Options”, “Combinations” (strangles; bottom vertical combination)
notes: Long a put below and a call above the spot: cheaper than a straddle, needs a larger move to pay.

reference: Hull, Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives (10th ed. 2018, 11th ed. 2021), ch. 12 “Trading Strategies Involving Options”, “Combinations” (top vertical combination or strangle write)
notes: Short a put below and a call above the spot: keeps both premiums while the underlying stays between the strikes; loss is unbounded above. B3 margin requirements are not modeled.
